article_context: Article image preceding the section about a disrupted flight on the way to the resort. It reinforces the promise that, despite changed travel plans, guests can still arrive and begin a calm mountain holiday.
image_reading: A couple in resort-casual clothing walks arm in arm along a sunlit pedestrian street toward the foreground.
The street opens onto green foothills and snow-covered mountains; the people remain the clear focal point.
Their clothing and the nearby trees can move subtly while the architecture and mountain backdrop stay stable.

models.positive_prompt: The couple walks arm in arm toward the camera at an easy, steady pace; their clothes and hair move lightly in the breeze. By the final frames they have taken several natural steps closer, still walking together calmly, with the mountains visible behind them.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the couple immediately continues their unhurried walk down the street toward the foreground. Keep a fixed camera centered on them; use subtle wind in hair and loose clothing as secondary motion. Their relaxed forward progress fills the shot, ending with them visibly closer to camera while still arm in arm and calm.

models.positive_prompt: A relaxed couple continues walking arm in arm toward the foreground, taking several even steps as a light breeze stirs their clothes. Fixed camera on the pair; in the final frame they are closer and still calmly proceeding together beneath the mountains.
models.scene_plan: For this five-second version, hold the camera fixed on the couple and let their walk develop evenly through most of the shot. Their connected pace remains simple and natural, supported by a faint breeze in their hair and clothes. Finish as they reach a clearly nearer position in the street without changing the peaceful holiday mood.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera: the couple walks arm in arm toward the foreground with two or three smooth, relaxed steps; a gentle breeze moves their hair and clothing. End with them noticeably closer to camera, still walking together calmly against the mountain view.
models.scene_plan: In four seconds, focus on the couple’s continuous forward walk. With the fixed camera preserving the mountain view, they take a small sequence of measured steps toward the foreground; only slight wind movement accompanies them. The shot ends as their nearer placement clearly confirms continued, relaxed arrival.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Even when travel plans are disrupted, guests can still reach the resort and move into a reassuring holiday experience.
structured_intent.primary_action: The couple continues walking together along the resort street.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: Their calm, confident sense of arriving for a mountain holiday remains unchanged.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The couple is visibly closer in the foreground, still walking arm in arm.
